evals.expected_output: One Operation from the canvas/plan was never implemented. The skill detects it, reports it as a concrete gap, and does not mark the scope as Verified.
evals.setup: Implement a feature but skip one Operation listed in the canvas, then run spdd-implement's Step 8 to mark it Implemented anyway.
assertions: The report explicitly names the missing Operation
The plan or canvas is not marked 'Status: Verified'
Nothing is moved to spdd/archive/ and spdd/specs/ is not modified

evals.expected_output: A Safeguards edge case has no existing test covering it. The skill writes and runs a targeted test for that exact scenario.
evals.setup: Implement a feature whose Safeguards section lists an edge case (e.g. related entity does not exist) with no corresponding test in the codebase.
assertions: A new test is written that targets the specific WHEN/THEN scenario from Safeguards
The new test is actually executed as part of verification
The report lists which Safeguards scenarios got a new test versus which were already covered

evals.expected_output: A legacy change migrated via spdd-migrate has no plans/ folder (spdd-implement now always requires one for new changes, but migrated changes predate that rule) and everything passes. The skill marks Status: Verified, folds the canvas into spdd/specs/<domain>.md, and moves the whole change folder to spdd/archive/.
evals.setup: Simulate a spdd-migrate result: place a canvas.md directly under spdd/changes/SPDD-slug/ with 'Status: Implemented' and no plans/ folder, with all Operations correctly implemented and tested.
assertions: canvas.md has 'Status: Verified'
spdd/specs/<domain>.md exists and contains the feature's Requirements/Operations after verification
The change folder no longer exists under spdd/changes/
The change folder now exists under spdd/archive/

evals.expected_output: A change has two plans; plan-01 passes verification but plan-02 is not yet implemented. The skill marks plan-01 as Verified but does NOT fold anything into spdd/specs/ or archive the change, since plan-02 is still pending.
evals.setup: Generate a canvas, split it into plan-01 and plan-02 with spdd-design, implement and verify only plan-01.
assertions: plan-01.md has 'Status: Verified'
No changes are made to any file under spdd/specs/
The change folder remains under spdd/changes/, not spdd/archive/

evals.expected_output: A Norm from the canvas (e.g. a stated project convention) was not followed in the implementation. The skill detects it, reports the concrete violation, and does not mark the scope as Verified.
evals.setup: Implement a feature that violates a Norm explicitly listed in the canvas (e.g. wrong file naming convention, missing required pattern).
assertions: The report names the specific Norm violated and where
The plan or canvas is not marked 'Status: Verified'

evals.expected_output: The target spdd/specs/<domain>.md already lists an Entity that this change's canvas also lists (same name, no NEW/MODIFIED marker involved since Entities don't carry one). Folding back updates that Entity's row in place instead of adding a duplicate row.
evals.setup: Verify a change whose canvas Entities section includes an entity with the same name as one already present in spdd/specs/<domain>.md.
assertions: spdd/specs/<domain>.md's Entities table has exactly one row for that entity name after folding
The row reflects the current (possibly updated) notes/path, not a stale duplicate of the old one

evals.expected_output: The Diff-to-canvas check runs and the real git diff covers exactly the Operations declared in the canvas, touching only declared Structure/Shared touchpoints. The check passes and Step 7 reports success without asking for confirmation.
evals.setup: Implement a feature from a canvas, commit changes, then run spdd-verify. Ensure the diff touches only files mentioned in Structure and Operations.
assertions: Step 7 (Diff-to-canvas check) reports the diff as coherent with the canvas
No AskUserQuestion prompt appears
The process continues to Step 8 (fold-back) without stopping

evals.expected_output: The Diff-to-canvas check detects that the real diff includes changes to a file that does not appear in Structure, Shared touchpoints, or Operations of the canvas. The check stops immediately, reports the concrete discrepancy (which file is undeclared), and does not fold anything to spdd/specs/.
evals.setup: Implement a feature but also modify a file not mentioned in the canvas (e.g., a config file or utility touched as a side effect). Commit and run spdd-verify.
assertions: Step 7 stops the process before fold-back
The report explicitly names the undeclared file touched by the diff
The plan/canvas is not marked 'Status: Verified'
spdd/specs/ is not modified and no fold occurs

evals.expected_output: The Diff-to-canvas check detects that one of the Operations listed in the canvas has no corresponding code changes in the real diff. The check stops immediately, reports the concrete gap (which Operation lacks implementation), and does not fold anything.
evals.setup: Generate a canvas with an Operation, but skip implementing that Operation in code (or implement it only partially in memory, not in the diff). Run spdd-verify.
assertions: Step 7 stops the process before fold-back
The report explicitly names the Operation with no corresponding diff changes
The plan/canvas is not marked 'Status: Verified'
No fold or archive occurs

evals.expected_output: The Diff-to-canvas check detects a discrepancy (e.g., a file outside declared scope or an Operation without implementation) in an interactive session. Using AskUserQuestion, the human confirms that the discrepancy is intentional. The check continues to Step 8, folds the result, and notes the accepted discrepancy.
evals.setup: Run spdd-verify in foreground (interactive) mode. Implement a feature with a deliberate discrepancy (undeclared file or missing Operation). When the Diff-to-canvas check prompts, answer 'yes' to confirm the discrepancy is intentional.
assertions: Step 7 calls AskUserQuestion to ask about the discrepancy
After user confirms, the process continues to Step 8 without stopping
The fold-back occurs normally
A note in the fold or archive reflects the accepted discrepancy

evals.expected_output: The Diff-to-canvas check detects a discrepancy while running as a background subagent under spdd-agent (no interactive AskUserQuestion available). The check does not block waiting for user input. Instead, it stops the process, leaves the plan/canvas unchanged, does not fold or archive, reports the gap, and appends a line '⚠️ Confirm: <discrepancy message>' to the plan/canvas.
evals.setup: Run spdd-agent on a feature that will diverge during implementation (undeclared file or missing Operation). Simulate spdd-verify running as a background subagent with the divergence present.
assertions: Step 7 detects the discrepancy without blocking
No AskUserQuestion is attempted (or if it is, it fails gracefully)
The plan/canvas is not marked 'Status: Verified'
A new line '⚠️ Confirm:' appears in the plan/canvas for later resolution
spdd/specs/ is not modified, no fold or archive occurs

evals.expected_output: The Diff-to-canvas check runs after Step 4 (Put the implementation to the test) has created new test files. Those test files appear in the diff but are not mentioned in the canvas Structure/Operations. The check correctly exempts them from the 'undeclared file' rule and does not block because of them.
evals.setup: Implement a feature with a plan that touches only certain files. Step 4 creates new test files (e.g., test_feature.py). Run the full spdd-verify flow. Ensure test files are created during this verification, not part of the original implementation.
assertions: Step 7 detects the test files in the diff
The check correctly identifies them as Step-4-generated (not original implementation)
They are exempted from scope validation
The Diff-to-canvas check passes without blocking on test files
The process continues to fold-back normally

evals.expected_output: spdd/norms.md exists and states a rule the implemented diff violates (e.g. a required architecture pattern or coding convention). The Diff-to-canvas check detects the violation, stops before fold-back, and reports the specific norm and file involved — even though the canvas itself has no matching Norm.
evals.setup: Create spdd/norms.md with a concrete, checkable rule under one of its sections. Implement a feature whose canvas doesn't restate that rule, but whose code violates it. Run spdd-verify.
assertions: Step 7 reads spdd/norms.md and checks the diff against it
The report names the specific rule from spdd/norms.md that was violated and the file that violates it
The plan/canvas is not marked 'Status: Verified'
spdd/specs/ is not modified and no fold or archive occurs

evals.expected_output: The verification scope includes a SKILL.md file that ships its own evals/evals.json, and the change in scope is non-trivial (adds new decision logic/a branch). In a foreground session, the skill asks via AskUserQuestion whether a lighter diff-based check is acceptable instead of running the harness; in background, it defaults to actually running the harness.
evals.setup: Implement a plan that modifies a SKILL.md file which has its own evals/evals.json, adding a new conditional branch to one of its steps. Run spdd-verify once in a foreground session and once as a background subagent under spdd-agent.
assertions: Foreground run: AskUserQuestion is used to ask whether a lighter diff-based check is acceptable
Background run: the eval harness is actually run rather than only reading the diff
Neither run silently treats a diff read alone as equivalent to re-running the evals
Step 4 reports which path (harness run vs. diff-based check) was taken and why

evals.expected_output: The verification scope contains no SKILL.md file at all (pure application/library code). The new eval-harness branch in Step 4 never triggers — Step 4 behaves exactly as before this change.
evals.setup: Implement a plan whose Structure only touches non-SKILL.md files (e.g. a script or config file), then run spdd-verify.
assertions: No AskUserQuestion about eval harnesses vs. diff-based checks is raised
No evals/evals.json file is read or executed as part of this verification
Step 4 completes using only the existing Safeguards-test-writing and test-suite-running behavior

evals.expected_output: During the Diff-to-canvas check (Step 7), the skill detects a discrepancy and writes a new '⚠️ Confirm:' discrepancy note directly into the plan/canvas. Even though the user's conversation with the agent is in Spanish, the note itself is written in English, consistent with the rest of the persisted document.
evals.setup: Run spdd-verify in a conversation conducted in Spanish, on a change whose diff includes an undeclared file (a Step 7 scope discrepancy), as a background subagent with no AskUserQuestion available.
assertions: The '⚠️ Confirm:' line appended to the plan/canvas is written in English, not Spanish
No other part of the plan/canvas is silently translated as a side effect
The plan/canvas is not marked 'Status: Verified'
